Politics · India

Leaders Extend Teachers' Day Greetings, Telangana Announces New Policy

On Teachers' Day, leaders across India extended greetings to educators, acknowledging their role in national development. In Telangana, Chief Minister Revanth Reddy announced a new education policy for the state. Governors and Deputy Chief Ministers also conveyed their wishes. The coverage highlights the importance of teachers in India's progress.
